item.title: Big Bear Mountain Resort Welcomes Winter Games Visitors with Fresh Snow, Sunshine, and Olympic Watch Parties
item.description: With fresh snow on the ground and sunny skies overhead, Big Bear Mountain Resort is inviting visitors to take advantage of prime winter conditions as Winter Games celebrations continue across the mountain.Resort officials say the combination of great weather and strong snow coverage makes this one of the best times to visit. item.title: USA Women's Hockey Wins Gold in Overtime Instant Classic
item.description: The United States women’s hockey team capped one of the most dominant runs in Olympic history with a 2-1 overtime win over Canada to claim gold in Milan. Team USA entered the showdown 6-0, outscoring opponents 31-1 with five straight shutouts and a record 331 minute, 23 second shutout streak — the longest in Olympic hockey history. item.title: Former Soccer Coach Sentenced to 61 Years for Sexual Abuse
item.description: A former Coachella Valley middle school soccer coach will spend more than six decades behind bars for sexually abusing students.Juan Manuel Pantoja Troncoso, 30, of Salton City was sentenced to 61 years and four months in state prison at the Banning Justice Center.A jury convicted him in October of multiple charges, including forcible lewd acts on a child and contacting minors to commit sexual offenses. item.title: Palm Springs Plaza Theatre Hosts Golden Age of Hollywood Showcase During Modernism Week
item.description: A special look back at the glamour and influence of Old Hollywood in Palm Springs is coming to the Palm Springs Plaza Theatre as Modernism Week continues across the Valley.The multimedia presentation, “Hollywood Meets the Palm Springs Plaza Theatre,” takes place tomorrow at 9:30 a.m. and will highlight the deep connection between the entertainment industry and the desert’s midcentury boom.The event is hosted by show business expert and historian Jim Cook and introduced by Lucy Arnaz. item.description: Firefighters with the Riverside County Fire Department rescued a hiker in a remote area near Mecca on Wednesday.Just before 1 p.m., crews responded to Ladder Canyon Trail after receiving reports of a hiker suffering a medical emergency. item.title: Eric Dane, Grey’s Anatomy and Euphoria Star, Dies at 53 After ALS Battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, widely known for his memorable roles on Grey’s Anatomy and Euphoria, has died at the age of 53, according to his publicist. He passed away Thursday following a battle with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease.In a statement, his family shared that Dane spent his final days surrounded by loved ones, including his wife and two daughters. item.title: Palm Springs Fix-It Fair Offers Free Household Repairs This Saturday
item.description: Palm Springs residents will have the opportunity to repair broken household items for free at an upcoming Fix-It Fair focused on sustainability and reuse.The City of Palm Springs Sustainability Department, in partnership with Repeat Reuse, is hosting the event this Saturday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Mizell Center.Volunteer repair experts will be on hand to help fix a variety of items, including bicycles, small appliances, clothing, toys, lamps, and tools. item.description: The Big Bear Alpine Zoo is playing a major role in the Winter Games celebrations, joining the Moon Ridge Winter Games Village as a hub for family-friendly activities and community engagement.Home to more than 190 animals, the zoo is expanding its role beyond wildlife education by supporting staffing and volunteers during the busy Winter Games period. item.title: Palm Springs International Airport Launches Biometric eGates to Speed Up Security Screening
item.description: Security screening is getting a high-tech upgrade at Palm Springs International Airport.The airport has officially rolled out biometric eGates, a new system designed to speed up the identity verification process for travelers.
